name: com.simowl/esim
title: SimOwl travel eSIM
description: Find prepaid travel eSIM plans for 148 countries, check eSIM phone support and estimate trip data.

tools.name: find_esim_plans
tools.description: Prepaid data-only travel eSIM plans sold by SimOwl for one country or multi-country region: data amount, validity in days, price (taxes included), networks, and a buy_url, cheapest first, e.g. for "eSIM for Morocco for 10 days". min_days filters by trip length and min_data_gb by data amount. Includes regional plans that also cover the country. No phone number or calls. Read-only: it never buys anything. The person buys on the site through the buy_url: the plan opens selected, they enter their email and pay; the QR code arrives by email within minutes.

destination.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("Japan", "JP"), or a region ("Europe", "Asia Pacific").

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to quote prices in (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY...). Defaults to EUR when not sold.

min_data_gb.description: Only plans with at least this much data (unlimited plans always match).

min_days.description: Only plans valid for at least this many days (trip length).

tools.name: list_esim_destinations
tools.description: Every country and multi-country region SimOwl sells travel eSIMs for, with the lowest price of each.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to quote prices in (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY...). Defaults to EUR when not sold.

type.description: Only countries or only multi-country regions.

tools.name: check_phone_esim_support
tools.description: Whether a phone model supports eSIM: "iPhone 13", "Galaxy S23", "Pixel 7a", or an Android model code such as "SM-S911B". Returns supported, not_supported or unknown.

tools.name: estimate_trip_data
tools.description: How much mobile data a trip needs, and the plan size to pick, for light, typical or heavy use.

profile.description: light: maps and messaging; typical: plus social, music, a little video; heavy: HD video, hotspot.
